question_vi: Cách kết hợp React Query với Next.js Server Components?
question_en: How do you combine React Query with Next.js Server Components?
answer_html_vi:
Server Component fetch data rồi dehydrate cache, Client Component nhận cache đã hydrate — không có flash loading.

tsx
// getQueryClient bọc trong cache() của React: mỗi request server một instance riêng
const getQueryClient = cache(() => new QueryClient())

export default async function Page() {
  const queryClient = getQueryClient()
  await queryClient.prefetchQuery({ queryKey: ['posts'], queryFn: fetchPosts })

  return (
    <HydrationBoundary state={dehydrate(queryClient)}>
      <PostList />
    </HydrationBoundary>
  )
}

Client Component vẫn dùng useQuery như bình thường — nhận data từ cache đã hydrate ngay, không gọi thêm request nếu data còn fresh.

  • Kết hợp Suspense để stream từng phần trang.
  • Không dùng được hook React Query trong RSC (RSC chỉ là async function) — hook chỉ chạy trong Client Component.
  • Prefetch trên server phần quan trọng cho lần render đầu, phần còn lại lazy load ở client.

Lưu ý: không bọc factory QueryClient trong cache() thì một QueryClient bị dùng chung cho mọi request → rò rỉ data giữa các user.
answer_html_en:
Server Components fetch the data and dehydrate the cache; Client Components pick up the hydrated cache — no loading flash.

tsx
// getQueryClient wrapped in React's cache(): one instance per server request
const getQueryClient = cache(() => new QueryClient())

export default async function Page() {
  const queryClient = getQueryClient()
  await queryClient.prefetchQuery({ queryKey: ['posts'], queryFn: fetchPosts })

  return (
    <HydrationBoundary state={dehydrate(queryClient)}>
      <PostList />
    </HydrationBoundary>
  )
}

The Client Component uses useQuery as usual — it reads from the hydrated cache immediately and issues no extra request while the data is still fresh.

  • Combine with Suspense to stream parts of the page.
  • React Query hooks cannot run in an RSC (those are plain async functions) — hooks belong in Client Components.
  • Prefetch on the server what the first render needs; lazy load the rest on the client.

Note: without cache() around the QueryClient factory, a single client is shared across every request → data leaks between users.
